title: SKE Crystal Plus Coconut Blast Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Coconut Blast flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods offer a wonderfully exotic and smooth vaping experience, combining the rich, creamy essence of coconut with a silky tropical sweetness. A delightfully indulgent vape, perfect for those who enjoy sweet and creamy flavours all day long. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods are the ideal solution for vapers seeking effortless, on-the-go satisfaction. Sharing the same radiant, crystalline design that made the SKE Crystal Bar disposables so popular, the Crystal Plus prefilled pods provide a more sustainable and convenient alternative. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, which delivers a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to standard freebase nicotine. Combined with an advanced 1.1ohm mesh coil, these pods produce incredible flavour and a super-satisfying MTL (Mouth-To-Lung) vaping experience. The user-friendly, prefilled design ensures that there’s no need for messy refills or coil changes – simply replace the pod when it’s empty, and you’re ready to continue enjoying the rich, indulgent flavour. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
